repos_data.description: [SUNSET] Initiate consistent EBS snapshots in Amazon EC2
A tool for creating EBS AMIs. This tool currently works for CentOS/RedHat Linux images and is intended to run on an EC2 instance.
Oh My Zsh plugin for interactive guided snapper snapshot creation on openSUSE Tumbleweed

repo_meta_data.description: A Python/Boto script that automates snapshot making of EBS volumes and rotating.
